hooks.command: FILE=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$FILE" ] || exit 0; echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.py$' || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && uv run ruff format --quiet "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; exit 0

FILE=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$FILE" ] || exit 0; echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(tsx?|jsx?|css)$' || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" && npx prettier --write "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

FILE=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$FILE" ] || exit 0; REL=${FILE#"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/}; case "$REL" in .env.example|*/.env.example) exit 0;; esac; if echo "$REL" | grep -qE '(^|/)\.env(\.[^/]+)?$|(^|/)uv\.lock$'; then echo "BLOCK: $REL is protected. .env files hold secrets and are never edited by an agent; uv.lock changes go through uv (uv lock / uv add)." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
